design_rationale:
WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST. The caller asks one ordinary thing - put the house credit my suite carries against what is on my room before I leave. Nothing in that sentence names the quantity that is scored, and nothing in it says that the credit account is empty. The desk capability being forced out is the one a real hotel agent needs: read a folio line by line, tell a room night from a room upgrade and a facility fee from a tax, tell the lead guest's charges from a companion's by the occupant each line names, read a club ledger through two different filters (tier-qualifying points for one rule, stay-night accruals for another) inside a twelve-month window, notice from the policy alone that the release waits on a state the records do not show, work out what that state is worth, place it, and only then price the release on the world as it now stands. The difficulty is in reading and arithmetic, never in choosing among similar tools: there are exactly two writes available to this task and each is named by exactly one policy.

SCOPE: ALREADY OCCUPIED / THIS TASK / STILL TO COME. This is the first task of the difficulty, so nothing was occupied before it. This task claims the property-credit pair and nothing else: stay_ext_arrival_credit_grant (subject stay_resort_credit_grant, tool post_arrival_credit_grant_b81202b7) and stay_ext_departure_credit_release (subject stay_resort_credit_use, tool apply_property_credit_f4ca2b6a). Reserved for task 1, whose draw is three prerequisite problems, are the posting and settlement subjects: stay_room_charge, stay_tax_and_fee_charge, stay_incidental_charge and stay_check_out, governed by stay_room_and_occupancy, stay_agg_portfolio_occupancy, stay_taxes_and_fees, stay_incidentals and stay_club_and_corporate_interaction. Left untouched by the difficulty altogether, and therefore free of any claim either task makes, are cancellation, no-show, refund settlement, best-rate settlement, modification and property-notice relocation. Task 1 therefore has a four-problem tree of its own with no policy, tool or subject shared with this task.

THE STEP 0 DRAW, AS PRINTED. `.venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0000_online_travel_agency/tasks/hotel_reservations_desk --tasks 2` prints for this task: {"task": 0, "key": "online_travel_agency/hotel_reservations_desk/0", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 6]}. The tree therefore has exactly one prerequisite problem, and the two computations carry 4 and 6 factors. stay_ext_arrival_credit_grant took the count 4; stay_ext_departure_credit_release took the count 6. The design was fitted to those numbers, not the other way round.

THE PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root problem: stay_ext_departure_credit_release, the problem the caller's request points at (she wants credit put against her charges). Prerequisite problem: stay_ext_arrival_credit_grant. One edge.
  edge stay_ext_departure_credit_release <- stay_ext_arrival_credit_grant
  kind: value_input. gate: grant_total, a compute binding of the blocked policy.
  form: state. prerequisite sentence (policy_source), quoted from the blocked policy's own rule: "The property credit released at the close of a stay is settled only after the reservation's credit account already carries the arrival grant the rate plan provides for that stay."
  FOUR-POINT TEST on that sentence. (1) Ordering connective: "only after" joins this policy's own result (the property credit released at the close of a stay) to the thing it waits on. (2) The XX side is a record-visible state - the reservation's credit account carrying the arrival grant - named in the words the reservation record and the folio finder use (credit account, grant, rate plan); it names no action, no performer and no tool. (3) It carries no tool name, no policy id, no snake_case token and no row id. (4) Strength and scope: "only after" is a hard requirement and matches the edge's condition exactly - the grant must stand, no wider (it does not require the credit to be unspent) and no narrower (it does not name an amount).
  STATE FORM LEGALITY: exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about. Across the whole charter the only policy whose subject is stay_resort_credit_grant, and the only target tool that creates a line of that event type, is stay_ext_arrival_credit_grant / post_arrival_credit_grant_b81202b7. A reader who sees that the state does not hold has exactly one write to reach for.
  DERIVATION, prerequisite sentence + records + the depended-on policy's rule -> the resolving action: the sentence says the release waits on the credit account carrying the arrival grant. The folio read at action 3 shows the credit account carrying two uses and no grant, and the reservation shows unspent property credit of -57.00, so the state does not hold. The other policy's own rule opens "The arrival credit is the property credit placed on a reservation once the guest has arrived" and is the only rule in the charter that says what places a grant on a reservation; so the one action that brings the state about is that policy's own, and it must be taken first. This admits exactly one reading.
  condition (handling-time state, an authoring field): "The reservation's credit account carries the arrival grant the rate plan provides for the stay."
  resolved_by: post_arrival_credit_grant_b81202b7, owner=agent.
  SEED EVIDENCE THAT THE EDGE IS FALSE AT THE OPENING: initial_state.stay_reservations.<res>.resort_credit_balance_usd = -57.00, and the only two credit-account lines on the folio are of event_type stay_resort_credit_use (-35.00 posted 2026-09-14, -22.00 posted 2026-09-16). No row of event_type stay_resort_credit_grant exists anywhere in the seed.
  TOPOLOGICAL ORDER: stay_ext_arrival_credit_grant, then stay_ext_departure_credit_release. The gold write nodes stand at action indices 8 and 10 in that order.
  PARALLEL EDGES: none - the tree is a chain of one edge, so there is nothing to reorder.
  DELETION SENSITIVITY, actually run: skipping the grant write and replaying the rest unchanged gives the release 0.00 instead of 117.84 (harness output "PREREQ skip: A0 without the arrival grant = 0.0 (with it: 117.84)"). The edge bears weight.
  THE PERSONA MENTIONS NO PREREQUISITE: see prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint. The words grant, credit account and balance do not occur in user_scenario; the caller has no figure in mind and never says anything is missing.
  THE TOOL LAYER VALIDATES NOTHING: see prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block. apply_property_credit_f4ca2b6a creates its line and restates the balance whatever the credit account holds.

WHY THE OWNER=USER WRITE IS GENUINELY THE CUSTOMER'S. The credit stands in the guest's name against her own reservation and spending it is a disposal of her own value, which is why the tool is owner=user and why the agent unlocks it at action 9 and hands it over rather than running it. It completes on the spot inside the same frozen time: the call writes one folio line and restates the reservation's unspent credit, with nothing to wait for. The persona carries the matching boundary in her own words - she is content for the desk to act for her on the property's side of the account, but would rather be the one to put the credit through.

THE BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Write 1, subject stay_resort_credit_grant. The only base policy whose subject intersects it is stay_resort_credit. Its single eligibility gate, guest_in_house, applies_to stay_resort_credit_use only, so no subject-scoped gate governs this write and the precondition is recorded as policy_scope: credit is placed at check-in, for the plan's amount per stay, a plan whose credit amount is zero grants none, and no credit is granted twice on one reservation. Evidence at frozen time: the reservation stands at checked_in, the plan is the Suite Flexible Rate whose resort_credit_per_stay_usd is 100.00 (not zero), and no grant line exists on the folio, so the once-only rule is not breached. Write 2, subject stay_resort_credit_use. The same base policy governs it and here guest_in_house does apply: "Property credit is spent only while the reservation record stands at checked in." Evidence: initial_state.stay_reservations.<res>.status = checked_in, correlated to the action by stay_reservation_id exactly as the gate's evidence_contract.action_bindings requires. POSITIVE AND NEGATIVE CASES for that state gate: on this world the status reads checked_in and the gate holds; had the guest already been moved to checked_out - which is what the departure this afternoon will produce - the gate would fail and the credit could not be spent, which is precisely why the release has to be settled before she leaves rather than after. There is no time eligibility on either write, so temporal_feasibility is [] and no anchor, counting rule or boundary is inherited.

THE BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The narrowest object is the single Portland reservation on the Suite Flexible Rate, correlation key stay_reservations.stay_reservation_id; every folio aggregate is scoped to that key. Rows included in each aggregate: the posted room total takes only the four charge_category=room_night lines (1580.00); the facility count takes only the four charge_category=resort_fee lines; the counted minibar takes the charge_category=incidental_minibar lines whose guest_sequence is 1; the lead treatment charges take the charge_category=incidental_spa lines whose guest_sequence is 1; the companion charges take every event_type=stay_incidental_charge line whose guest_sequence is 2. Rows deliberately excluded and why: the two room_upgrade lines are event_type stay_room_charge but charge_category room_upgrade, so they are not room nights; the deposit of 790.00 is charge_category deposit; the four occupancy_tax and four city_tax lines are not the property facility fee; the property notice carries no money; and the credit-use lines move the credit account, not the folio. Objects already settled: the two credit uses of 35.00 and 22.00 each carry source_entry_id pointing at the exact folio line they were signed against (the 148.00 spa line and the 12.70 minibar line), so there is no aggregation by customer or by case reference anywhere. The write the guest makes carries source_folio_entry_id back to the single folio line the rule names, the largest treatment charge.

THE FACTOR CARD - stay_ext_arrival_credit_grant (4 factors: 3 parameter, 1 method).
  measured_base_credit_basis (method). Ladder: room nights posted at or above the premium room spend of 1500 -> the premium credit rate of 4 per cent of the posted room total; at or above the standard room spend of 800 -> the standard credit rate of 2.5 per cent; otherwise the plan's flat credit amount. Tier taken here: the first, because the four room-night lines come to 1580.00. Evidence rows: the four charge_category=room_night lines of 395.00. Baseline reading: the plan's credit amount for the stay, 100.00; substituting it gives 160.00 against gold 123.20. This is a genuine method change - a percentage of spend replaces a flat figure, which is how a resort varies a house credit for a high-spending stay - not a number swapped inside one formula.
  club_tier_allowance (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty on club). Ladder: Platinum/Titanium/Ambassador AND qualifying points at or above 40,000 -> 45.00; Gold AND qualifying points at or above 15,000 -> 25.00; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the Gold one. Evidence rows: the club membership row (variant_name Wanderlane Gold, status active) and the club ledger rows of 2025-11-08, 2026-02-19, 2026-03-14, 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-27, which sum to 19,020 qualifying points. Baseline reading: nil; substituting gives 98.20 against gold 123.20. NEAR-MISS: the spendable row of 12,000 posted 2026-05-20 and the qualifying row of 5,600 posted 2025-06-15 both look like qualifying points to a careless reader; the first fails the points_kind filter and the second falls outside the twelve-month window, and the rule states both exclusions.
  stay_length_allowance (parameter). Ladder: 7 nights or more -> 40.00; 4 nights or more -> 20.00; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the second - 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-17 is four nights. Baseline nil; substituting gives 103.20.
  facility_fee_allowance (parameter). Ladder: 6 facility-fee nights or more -> 30.00; 3 or more -> 15.00; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the second - four resort_fee lines. Baseline nil; substituting gives 108.20. NEAR-MISS: the four occupancy_tax and four city_tax lines bring the count to twelve for anyone who reads "taxes and fees" as one family, which would select the top tier; the rule says in terms that only the property facility fee is counted and that occupancy tax, city tax and parking are not.
  WHOLE-BASELINE FALL-BACK: 100.00, the figure an agent reaches who finds the computation document and none of the factor documents. It differs from gold.
THE FACTOR CARD - stay_ext_departure_credit_release (6 factors: 4 parameter, 2 method).
  credit_standing_basis (method, multi-source). Ladder: a property notice on the folio AND departure no later than the settlement day -> the grant in full with the uses set aside; no property notice AND departure no later than the settlement day -> nil, the credit having lapsed; otherwise the grant less every use. Tier taken: the first - notice PDX119-N4412 posted 2026-09-14 and a departure date of 2026-09-17 equal to the day of settlement. Baseline: the grant less every use, 66.20 against gold 117.84. The three tiers are three different ways of measuring the same quantity, and the middle one is base's own forfeiture rule.
  treatment_share_tier (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty on club). Ladder: Platinum/Titanium/Ambassador AND 8 stay-night accruals or more in twelve months -> 25 per cent; Gold AND 3 or more -> 20 per cent; otherwise 15 per cent. Tier taken: the Gold one, on the four stay-night accrual rows of 2025-11-08, 2026-02-19, 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-27. Baseline 15 per cent, giving 111.68. NEAR-MISS: the stay-night row of 2025-06-15 is the fifth such row but falls outside the window; and the undecided status challenge claiming Wanderlane Platinum, read at action 6, is not a tier held.
  minibar_charge_selection (method). Ladder: 4 minibar charges or more AND 8 on-site charges or more -> every minibar charge taken by the lead guest, total 55.20; 4 or more minibar charges AND fewer than 8 on-site charges -> the largest lead minibar charge alone; otherwise the latest lead minibar charge alone. Tier taken: the first, on five minibar lines and eight on-site lines. Baseline: the latest lead minibar charge, 12.70, giving 75.34. This is a selection rule - which candidate lines are taken - not a number swap.
  minibar_cover_tier (parameter). Ladder: minibar charges at or above 100.00 -> 100 per cent; at or above 40.00 -> 75 per cent; otherwise 50 per cent. Tier taken: the first, the minibar coming to 113.50. Baseline 50 per cent, giving 90.24.
  upgrade_credit_tier (parameter). Ladder: an upgrade charged for 5 nights or more -> 20.00 a night; 2 nights or more -> 10.00 a night; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the second, two upgrade nights. Baseline nil a night, giving 97.84.
  companion_allowance_tier (parameter, multi-source). Ladder: the plan lets a companion spend the credit AND 3 or more on-site charges taken by another occupant -> 18.00; the plan lets a companion spend AND 1 or 2 such charges -> 9.00; otherwise nil. Tier taken: the first - the Suite Flexible Rate's resort_credit_transferable is true and Theo's three charges (120.00, 31.00, 27.30) are on the folio. Baseline nil, giving 99.84.
  WHOLE-BASELINE FALL-BACK: 16.28, differing from gold 117.84.
  This customer sits off the fall-through of all ten declared factors across the two computations, so every factor bites; one factor of the task is multi-source in four different places and two are cross-difficulty on club.

WHICH BASE BOUNDARIES ARE INHERITED, AND WHAT IS OVERRIDDEN. Everything in stay_resort_credit that is not named in an overwrite stays in force and is relied on: credit is spent against charges taken at the property and never on the room rate, taxes or the agency service fee; a companion may spend it only where the plan allows; a plan whose credit is zero grants none; no credit is granted twice; and credit is spent only while the reservation stands at checked_in. Two clauses are superseded, each declared sentence by sentence. stay_ext_arrival_credit_grant supersedes "Property credit included in the rate plan is placed on the reservation at check-in, for the plan's amount per stay and not per night" because on this world base would give 100.00 and the extended policy gives 123.20 - the measurement basis is what changes, not the parameter, and resort_credit_per_stay_usd remains base's number and remains the extended baseline. stay_ext_departure_credit_release supersedes "The credit lapses at the end of the plan's validity term counted from the arrival date, and whatever is unspent at departure is forfeited without payment" because its first tier restores a grant that base would forfeit. No second product law was created: every factor reads either a charter parameter of the plan, a base charter asset, or the records.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS, AND WHAT WOULD CHANGE WITHOUT IT. The four room_night lines carry the posted room total; delete one and the total falls to 1185.00, below the premium room spend, and the measured base credit drops from 63.20 to 29.63. The four resort_fee lines carry the facility allowance; delete two and it falls from 15.00 to nil. The four occupancy_tax and four city_tax lines exist to be excluded: they are the facility factor's near-miss and are owed on the nights stayed, so leaving them out would have left an obligation this task does not carry. The two room_upgrade lines carry the upgrade credit, and are also excluded from the posted room total because the rule counts room-night lines alone; delete them and the covered upgrade amount falls from 20.00 to nil. The three spa lines split lead from companion: the 148.00 line is both the largest treatment charge the release is recorded against and part of the 245.00 the treatment release is capped by, and the 120.00 line is a companion charge. The five minibar lines carry the selection method, the cover rate and the counted figure. The two credit-use lines make the fall-through of credit_standing_basis differ from its first tier (without them the grant in full and the grant less uses would be the same number and that factor would be decoration) and they are the reason the credit account reads below zero. The property notice puts the customer on the first tier of that same factor. The deposit of 790.00 is the money the property took when it confirmed and is excluded from every aggregate. On the club side, the membership row decides two tiers, five ledger rows carry the qualifying sum and the stay-night count, and two rows exist only to be excluded. The undecided status challenge is a pure trap.
AUTOMATIC-CLAUSE CHECK. Base's automatic consequences on a checked_in reservation are the room nights posted from check-in, the taxes and fees owed on those nights, and the arrival credit the plan carries. The first two are seeded complete for all four nights; the third is exactly the obligation this task discharges. Nothing else is lit: no cancellation or no-show status, no approved relocation behind the property notice (so stay_evt_property_notice owes no allowance and none is posted), no refund payout (which base would refuse anyway while the reservation stands at checked_in), and no best-rate claim. CACHE CHECK: no cache trap is designed here. folio_balance_usd is exactly the sum of the money lines (3539.22) and resort_credit_balance_usd is exactly the sum of the credit lines (-57.00); both are true statements of the ledger, and the negative credit balance is a real consequence of the front desk having signed charges against a credit that was never placed, not a stale figure.

THE PERSONA. Nadia Ferreira is written as a practical, slightly rushed professional calling from the room on her departure morning; the voice is unhurried and concrete, and the information arrives in the order a real caller offers it - the request first, the authorisation boundary second, identity only when asked, details about her partner and the car park only when asked. What she volunteers: that her suite carries a house credit to spend on site, that there is a spa bill and a fair amount of minibar on the room, and that she leaves this afternoon. All three are entailed by the opening world: the plan booked carries credit, the folio carries three spa and five minibar lines, and check_out_date is 2026-09-17. What she gives only on request: her name, the number held against the booking, her date of birth, the last four of her passport, that Theo has been charging to the room, that they used no car park, and that she cannot produce the confirmation number. What she reacts to rather than initiates: she says good, thank you when told something has been put right on the property's side, and she runs the credit step only after the agent has explained it and handed it to her, reading back what comes out. Natural traps: she says she is a Wanderlane Gold member, which agrees with the record, but an agent who goes looking will find a status challenge claiming Platinum that has not been decided. She has no figure of her own, so she can neither confirm nor contradict a wrong answer, and the persona says in terms that she takes what she is told at face value. The ending closes exactly where evaluation_criteria closes: the last thing she does is run the credit step and thank the agent, and she asks for nothing beyond it - no document, no address, no statement.

THE PREREQUISITE CHAIN THE AGENT MUST DISCOVER, AND WHY IT CANNOT BE REORDERED. Surface goal (put the credit against my charges) -> the release policy's own rule, which says the release is settled only after the credit account carries the arrival grant -> the folio, which shows two uses and no grant and an unspent credit of -57.00 -> the only rule in the charter that says what places a grant on a reservation -> its own computation, which must be worked out and written first -> the release, priced on the world the grant has made. Reordering is impossible because the release reads the grant total: settle first and the answer is 0.00. DEPTH is that one hop; BREADTH is what feeds each end of it - the release alone draws on six independent rules reading the folio five different ways (credit lines, spa lines by occupant, minibar lines by occupant, upgrade lines, on-site line counts), the property notice, the departure date, the plan's transferability parameter, and the club ledger through a twelve-month window; the grant draws on the room total, the facility-fee count, the nights covered and the same club ledger through a different filter. Remove any one of them and a value changes, as the factor card's baseline figures show.

WHERE A CARELESS AGENT GOES WRONG, AND HOW THE POLICY EXCLUDES IT. Counting the room upgrade into the posted room total (the rule says only room-night lines). Counting occupancy tax and city tax as facility fee (the rule names the exclusion). Summing every points row in the club ledger instead of the tier-qualifying ones, or forgetting the twelve-month window (the rule states both filters). Treating the claimed Platinum tier as held (the rule reads the tier the active membership stands at). Counting Theo's spa charge into the lead guest's treatment charges (the rule says the treatment charges taken by the lead guest, and every line names its occupant). Deducting the two credit uses from the grant when the property notice stands (the first tier of credit_standing_basis sets them aside). Pricing the release on the opening world, before the grant is placed, which gives 0.00. Each of these is decided by a sentence of the published rule, not by judgement.

THE STANDARD SOLUTION. Find the traveller by name and telephone number; verify with date of birth and passport last four. Read the reservation: Suite Flexible Rate, checked_in, 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-17, two adults, one room, unspent property credit -57.00. Read the folio: four room nights at 395.00, four facility fees at 45.00, four occupancy taxes, four city taxes, two upgrade nights at 125.00, three spa lines (148.00 and 97.00 for the lead guest, 120.00 for the second occupant), five minibar lines (24.00, 18.50, 12.70 for the lead guest; 31.00 and 27.30 for the second occupant), two credit uses and one property notice. Read the club membership (Wanderlane Gold, active) and its ledger. Read the tier reviews and set the undecided Platinum claim aside. Assemble the arrival credit: 4 per cent of 1580.00 = 63.20, plus the senior uplift 25.00, plus the short stay allowance 20.00, plus the part facility offset 15.00 = 123.20, and its expiry 2026-09-13 + 7 days = 2026-09-20. Place it. Then assemble the release on the world that grant has made: credit standing 123.20 (notice on file, departing today), treatment share 20 per cent -> allowance 24.64, capped by lead treatments 245.00 -> 24.64; remaining allowance 98.56; counted minibar 55.20 at 100 per cent -> 55.20; upgrade 2 x 10.00 -> 20.00; companion allowance 18.00 capped by 178.30 -> 18.00; covered remaining 93.20, which is under 98.56 -> 93.20. Hand the step to the guest; she writes 24.64 + 93.20 = 117.84.

THE VERIFICATION CODE AND ITS OUTPUT. The Step 5 harness builds the world from initial_state, evaluates stay_ext_arrival_credit_grant on the opening world, replays the real grant tool onto a copy, evaluates stay_ext_departure_credit_release on that handling-time world, substitutes each declared factor's baseline in turn and all of them at once, and replays the release with the grant skipped. Its output, reproduced verbatim from the run: "B0 stay_ext_arrival_credit_grant result = 123.2 (history rows 9, branches 10)"; "sens measured_base_credit_basis -> 160.0"; "sens club_tier_allowance -> 98.2"; "sens stay_length_allowance -> 103.2"; "sens facility_fee_allowance -> 108.2"; "whole baseline -> 100.0"; "A0 stay_ext_departure_credit_release result = 117.84 (history rows 14, branches 17)"; "sens credit_standing_basis -> 66.2"; "sens treatment_share_tier -> 111.68"; "sens minibar_charge_selection -> 75.34"; "sens minibar_cover_tier -> 90.24"; "sens upgrade_credit_tier -> 97.84"; "sens companion_allowance_tier -> 99.84"; "whole baseline -> 16.28"; "PREREQ skip: A0 without the arrival grant = 0.0 (with it: 117.84)". Every figure here is the figure recorded in computations, and the gate re-derives all of them: `check_compute.py ... --task 0` prints comps 2, fact 10, xfac 2, hist 23, brch 27, step 11, match True.

FORWARD AND REVERSE SWEEP, rule <-> compute_basis <-> compute. Forward: every binding of both policies that reads the world, aggregates, chooses, crosses a category, caps or rounds carries a verbatim quotation of the rule sentence it implements - checked mechanically, every compute_basis value is a whitespace-insensitive substring of its own policy's rule. Sensitive-word cross-check: "in the last twelve months" in the tier quotations against within_months=12 on both XSUM and XCOUNT; "tier-qualifying" against points_kind='qualifying'; "recorded against a hotel night" against accrual_source='stay_night'; "taken by the lead guest" against guest_sequence=1; "taken by an occupant other than the lead guest" against guest_sequence=2; "rounded to the cent" against every RND(...,2); "whichever is the smaller" against every MN. Reverse: sweeping each rule for load-bearing promises, every quantity, window, filter, branch, cap and rounding it states has a binding - the measured base, the three allowances and their ladders in the grant policy; the credit standing, the treatment share and allowance and release, the remaining allowance and release, the counted minibar, the cover rate, the covered minibar, the upgrade credit and covered upgrade, the companion allowance and release, and the covered remaining total in the release policy. The ordering and grouping semantics that genuinely exist are pinned in prose: the grant says the four parts are "added together and the total rounded to the cent"; the release says the treatment allowance is taken from the credit standing first and that "What is left of the credit standing after the treatment allowance is set aside is the remaining allowance", so the two caps act on named intermediates and not on each other; each cap is stated as "whichever is the smaller" against a named pair; and the rounding point is stated at each intermediate that rounds. No binding carries a filter the rule does not state, and no rule sentence promises a quantity no binding produces.

POLICY / GT CLOSURE. stay_ext_arrival_credit_grant -> post_arrival_credit_grant_b81202b7 -> computations[0] step 8 arg credit_amount_usd = 123.20 -> evaluation_criteria[8] -> a grant line of 123.20 on the folio and the reservation's unspent credit restated to 66.20. stay_ext_departure_credit_release -> apply_property_credit_f4ca2b6a -> computations[1] step 10 arg credit_applied_usd = 117.84 -> evaluation_criteria[10] -> a credit-use line of -117.84 recorded against the 148.00 spa line and the balance restated to -51.64. The write order matches the topological order of the tree. charter_scope, required_documents and the computations' policy ids are the same two ids in the same order, and the task tools are the two the gold actually calls in first-use order. No policy, tool or obligation hangs outside the tree.

THE ELIGIBILITY EVIDENCE IN solvability_contract AGAINST GT. Step 8 carries one precondition, stay_resort_credit at policy_scope, evidenced by the reservation's status, its rate plan and its unspent credit - all pre-action initial_state rows, all on the object the call names. Step 10 carries one precondition, stay_resort_credit.guest_in_house, whose condition is quoted verbatim, whose evidence covers both of the gate's evidence_fields, and whose single evidence binding ties stay_reservations.stay_reservation_id to the call's stay_reservation_id exactly as the gate's action_bindings prescribe, with the value read from the seed row and equal to the gold argument. Both stages are honest: step 8 is performed_by_this_tool and step 10 is established_by_prior_tool citing prior_step:8, which is a real synchronous DB effect of this conversation and not a status registration standing in for an outside event. Nothing in this task waits on a diagnosis, a delivery, a payment clearing, a manual review, a batch or a future date; both writes land inside the one frozen time 2026-09-17 09:25:00 UTC.

THE DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT ALONE. Masking the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this dossier, and working only from the prose that will be published, the tool schemas, what the finders return and what the caller actually says: the caller wants credit put against her charges; the release rule says that is settled only after the credit account carries the arrival grant; the folio shows no grant and an unspent credit of -57.00, so it is not; the grant rule is the only one that says what places a grant, so the grant is worked out first - 1580.00 of room nights at 4 per cent is 63.20, Gold with 19,020 qualifying points in the window adds 25.00, four nights adds 20.00, four facility-fee nights adds 15.00, total 123.20, expiring 2026-09-20. user_scenario:
Nadia Ferreira is a landscape architect from Portland who travels for work about once a month and has stayed at the Cascade Row on the east side of the river often enough that the night staff know her usual order. She is calling from the room itself a little after nine in the morning, suitcase half packed, because she checks out this afternoon and wants the house credit her suite carries put against the charges that have piled up on the room before the bill is settled. She puts it plainly and without jargon: her suite comes with a house credit to spend on site, there is a spa bill and a fair amount of minibar sitting on the room now, and she would like that credit set against what is on her room before she leaves today. She does not know how the credit is worked out, she has never asked, and she has no figure of her own in mind; whatever the desk tells her the credit comes to, she takes as read.

She is content for the desk to act for her on the property's side of the account, and says so plainly if the agent asks whether it may. Spending the credit itself is a different matter: it is her credit and her room, and she says she would rather be the one to put it through, so once the agent has that step ready and hands it over she will run it herself and read back whatever comes out of it.

She gives her name as Nadia Ferreira when she is asked who is calling, and volunteers nothing else about herself. If the agent asks for the number held against the booking she reads out 4692310884. If she is asked her date of birth she gives 1981-04-22, and if asked for the last four of her passport she reads 1274 off the document in the room safe. She cannot produce the confirmation number and says so if pressed, because it is in an email she cannot get at on the room wifi, and she asks the desk to find the booking from her own details instead. She knows she is a Wanderlane Gold member and will say so if the club comes up, but she cannot recall the membership number and suggests the agent look it up rather than guess.

She is travelling with her partner Theo, who shares the room and has signed for some of the spa and the minibar himself; whenever the agent asks whether anyone else has been charging to the room she confirms that he has, and that he was with her the whole stay. If she is asked whether she used the hotel car park she says no, they walked and took the tram all week and the car stayed at home. If she is asked whether she wants anything posted or emailed to her she says no, the folio that lands in her inbox at checkout is fine.

She reacts rather than leads. Whenever the agent tells her that something has been put right on the property's side of the account she says good, thank you, and waits to be told what comes next. When the agent explains what the credit will cover and hands her the step to run, she runs it and reads the confirmation back word for word. Once she has done that and heard that the credit now stands against her room, she thanks the agent warmly, says that is exactly what she wanted settled before she leaves, and rings off. If the agent misses something, or gives her a figure that is wrong, she has no way of knowing and does not object; she takes what she is told at face value and does not go looking for the rest.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Select the traveller profile the caller is speaking from, by the name she gives and the number held against her booking, and read the internal traveller reference every later lookup needs.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Without the traveller reference nothing on the account can be reached: the reservation, the folio and the club membership are all located from it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Establish that the caller really is the traveller whose profile has been found, by checking two details she states against the profile on file, and record the outcome.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No charge, credit or folio line may be discussed or moved before the caller has been identified in this conversation.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull the guest's hotel reservations and read the one she is calling from: the rate plan booked, where it stands in its life, the arrival and departure dates, the occupancy, and the unspent property credit shown against it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The rate plan fixes the plan's credit amount, its validity term and whether a companion may spend the credit; the arrival and departure dates fix the nights the reservation covers and whether the stay ends today; the reservation reference scopes every folio read that follows.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull every line standing on this reservation's folio: the room nights, the property facility fee, the occupancy and city taxes, the room upgrade, the spa and minibar charges, the credit already spent at the front desk and the property's own notice.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The posted room total decides how the base credit is measured, the count of facility-fee nights decides the facility allowance, and the minibar, upgrade, spa and companion lines decide every part of what the credit releases; the credit lines and the notice decide what stands unspent.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the traveller club membership held against this guest: the tier it stands at and whether it is active.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier the active membership stands at is one of the two conditions deciding the tier allowance added to the arrival credit and the treatment share of the closing release.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull the ledger rows posted to that membership so the tier-qualifying points of the last twelve months and the stay-night accruals of the last twelve months can each be counted.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The qualifying points of the last twelve months are the second condition of the tier allowance, and the number of stay-night accruals in the same window is the second condition of the treatment share; the spendable row and the row posted more than twelve months back must be left out of both.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the reviews the member has put to the programme office, so that a tier she has claimed but that has not been decided is not mistaken for the tier her membership stands at.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: A status challenge claiming Wanderlane Platinum stands undecided against this membership; both the tier allowance and the treatment share read the tier the active membership stands at, so the claimed tier must be seen and set aside rather than used.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the desk-side action that places property credit on a reservation so it can be called.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock/call pair; it has no effect on the records and happens once for this action in this task.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Place the arrival credit the stay carries onto the reservation's credit account, stamped with the last date it may be spent, so that the credit account carries the grant the rate plan provides.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Only this policy's computation produces the arrival credit, and only once the grant stands on the credit account does the closing release have a credit standing to work from.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.stay_reservation_id: Value: the internal reference of the Portland reservation on the Suite Flexible Rate. Basis: the reservation record returned at action 2 is the only hotel reservation held in this guest's name, and its status field reads checked_in while its property city reads Portland, which is the stay the caller says she checks out of this afternoon. Uniqueness: the lookup at action 2 returns exactly one reservation for this traveller, so no other reference can be meant; the value is copied from that record and is never stated by the caller.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_amount_usd: Value: 123.20. The arrival credit is a measured base credit plus three allowances, added and rounded to the cent. Measured base credit: the room nights already posted to this folio come to 1580.00 (four nights at 395.00; the two room-upgrade lines of 125.00 are not room nights and are not counted, and the deposit of 790.00 is not a room night either), which is at or above the premium room spend of 1500, so the premium credit rate of 4 per cent applies rather than the standard rate of 2.5 per cent: 1580.00 x 4 / 100 = 63.20. Tier allowance: the guest's active membership stands at Wanderlane Gold, and the tier-qualifying points posted to it in the twelve months to 2026-09-17 come to 19,020 (3,120 + 2,450 + 6,400 + 4,150 + 2,900), at or above the senior qualifying points of 15,000; the spendable row of 12,000 is not tier-qualifying and the qualifying row of 5,600 posted 2025-06-15 falls outside the window, so neither is counted; the senior uplift of 25.00 applies. Length allowance: the reservation covers 4 nights from 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-17, at or above the short stay nights of 4 but below the extended stay nights of 7, so the short stay allowance of 20.00 applies. Facility allowance: the folio carries 4 nights of property facility fee, at or above the part facility nights of 3 but below the full facility nights of 6, so the part facility offset of 15.00 applies; the four occupancy-tax and four city-tax lines are not the property facility fee and are not counted. 63.20 + 25.00 + 20.00 + 15.00 = 123.20.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_expiry_date: Value: 2026-09-20. Basis: this policy's own rule states verbatim that 'The arrival credit is recorded with the last date it may be spent, which is the arrival date advanced by the rate plan's credit validity term.' The reservation record read at action 2 gives the arrival date as 2026-09-13 and the rate plan booked as the Suite Flexible Rate, whose credit validity term is 7 days. Uniqueness: 2026-09-13 advanced by 7 days is 2026-09-20 and no other date; the rule names the arrival date as the anchor, so neither the booking date, the confirmation moment nor the departure date can be used instead.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Spending the credit is the guest's own disposal of value standing in her name, so the action is hers to run; unlocking it has no effect on the records and happens once for this action in this task.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_folio_entry_id: Value: the internal reference of the 148.00 spa line posted on 2026-09-14. Basis: this policy's own rule states verbatim that 'The closing credit release is recorded as one line against the largest treatment charge standing on the folio, and no separate line is raised for each charge it covers.' The folio read at action 3 carries three treatment charges: 148.00 on 2026-09-14, 97.00 on 2026-09-15 and 120.00 on 2026-09-15. Uniqueness: 148.00 is the largest of the three, so exactly one folio line answers the rule; the 120.00 line is larger than the 97.00 line but smaller than 148.00, and no other treatment charge stands on this folio.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_applied_usd: Value: 117.84. The closing credit release is the treatment release plus the remaining release, rounded to the cent. Credit standing: the folio carries a property notice about this reservation (reference PDX119-N4412, posted 2026-09-14) and the departure date 2026-09-17 is no later than the day of settlement, so the credit standing is the arrival grant in full, 123.20, and the two uses of 35.00 and 22.00 already posted at the front desk are set aside. Treatment share: the active membership stands at Wanderlane Gold and the stay-night accruals posted to it in the twelve months to 2026-09-17 number 4 (2025-11-08, 2026-02-19, 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-27), at or above the regular stay rows of 3, while the stay-night row of 2025-06-15 falls outside the window; so the regular treatment share of 20 per cent applies. Treatment allowance = 123.20 x 20 / 100 = 24.64; the treatment charges taken by the lead guest come to 245.00 (148.00 + 97.00; the 120.00 treatment was taken by the second occupant), so the treatment release is the smaller figure, 24.64. Remaining allowance = 123.20 - 24.64 = 98.56. edges.condition: The reservation's credit account carries the arrival grant the rate plan provides for the stay.
edges.policy_source: The property credit released at the close of a stay is settled only after the reservation's credit account already carries the arrival grant the rate plan provides for that stay.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: No grant line stands on this reservation's credit account at all. The account carries only two uses the property's own front desk let the guest sign against the credit her plan carries, so the unspent property credit shown on the reservation reads -57.00 rather than the plan's credit for the stay. The state the release waits on therefore does not hold at frozen time.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Once the arrival credit is placed on the reservation, a grant line of 123.20 stands on the credit account, the grant total the release reads becomes 123.20 instead of 0.00, and the reservation's unspent property credit is restated to 66.20.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a single chain with one edge, so there is no pair of prerequisites that could be taken in either order: the grant must be placed before the release is settled, and the release is the last write. The verification run confirms the point from the other side - settling the release first gives 0.00 rather than 117.84, so the two writes do not commute and no second ordering produces the gold terminal state.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the arrival grant and replaying the rest unchanged leaves the grant total at 0.00, so the credit standing falls from 123.20 to 0.00, the treatment allowance from 24.64 to 0.00 and the remaining allowance from 98.56 to 0.00; the closing credit release computes as 0.00 instead of 117.84, and the terminal folio carries no grant line and a credit-use line of a different amount.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona never mentions the arrival grant, the credit account being empty or in deficit, or anything having to be put right before the credit can be spent. She asks only for the credit her suite carries to be set against what is on her room, which is the root problem, and she explicitly has no figure of her own in mind. She does not read the unspent-credit figure off any statement and never says that anything is missing; the words grant, credit account and balance do not occur in her lines at all. Her only contribution touching the prerequisite is passive: when the agent tells her something has been put right on the property's side she says good, thank you, and waits.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: The release tool apply_property_credit_f4ca2b6a in task_tools.py performs one ctx.create of the credit-use line and one restatement of the reservation's credit balance. It reads the reservation only to copy the customer reference and reads the folio only to copy the credit reference of an existing grant, defaulting both to an empty string when none is found; it never tests whether a grant exists, never raises, never returns an error and gives no hint. Called before the grant is placed it still writes faithfully, and the only consequence of skipping the grant shows up in the terminal hash.
